value.name: ignores Rosa's unanswered call
value.description: Asha does not check whether Rosa has answered the phone call before going home.
evidence: she did not turn the phone over to see whether Rosa had answered

value.name: books Thursday evening train
value.description: At home, Asha uses her laptop to book a Thursday evening regional rail departure that will let her finish her last deposition first.
evidence: At home she set the phone face up on the kitchen counter and opened her laptop beside it, the cursor blinking through the regional rail site until she found a Thursday evening departure that would clear her last deposition by an hour. She booked the seat under her own card

value.name: waits for confirmation before checking phone
value.description: Asha completes the booking and only then turns over her phone to silence the notifications.
evidence: only when the confirmation email landed did she turn the phone over to silence its notifications

value.name: reads Rosa's travel message
value.description: Asha sees Rosa's message wishing her safe travels and offering to check in later.
evidence: Rosa's message was already there: Safe travels tomorrow. Let me check in with you later.

value.name: chooses not to reply
value.description: Asha reads Rosa's message twice and deliberately leaves it unanswered, treating the silence as a response.
evidence: Asha read it once and did not answer, then read it again and left the screen lit on the counter
aware that not answering was its own reply

value.name: packs a bag while withholding response
value.description: Asha goes to find a bag, expecting Rosa to understand her silence even if she may not forgive it.
evidence: while she went to find a bag
Rosa, who had heard about Trenton before she had, would understand the shape of the silence even if she did not forgive it

value.name: sends polite thank-you text
value.description: Asha sends Rosa a brief, carefully measured thank-you message before she can adjust its tone.
evidence: Asha picked it up, thumbed out a short line—Thank you, Rosa. I appreciate the thought—and sent it before she could revise the warmth up or down

value.name: receives Rosa's follow-up offer
value.description: Rosa immediately replies, telling Asha to reach out if she needs anything while away.
evidence: It buzzed almost at once, and she turned it over: Safe travels. Reach out if you need anything while you're there.

value.name: leaves Rosa unanswered again
value.description: Asha reads Rosa's follow-up once and does not respond, leaving her half-packed bag open behind her.
evidence: She read it once and left it there, not answering, the bag she had half-packed waiting open on a kitchen chair behind her

value.name: recognizes Rosa will persist
value.description: Asha understands that Rosa will continue trying to stay in contact despite the silence.
